title: A Pocketful of Spark Plugs
summary: Solder's saddlebag split mid-yard and six reconditioned ignition plugs seeded themselves along the fence line and the sorted pile. Sweep them up before the mag-crane mistakes them for lunch.

objectives.label: Sweep the fence line by the yard gate — three plugs
Comb the sorted parts pile — three more plugs

offer.text: Okay. Small disaster. My saddlebag seam lied to me — honest stitching would never — and six plugs are now distributed across the fence line like very gross seed crystal.
They're porcelain-shouldered, so don't park on them. And if the mag-crane eats one, that's between you and the crane. I will absolve nobody.

accept.text: Six plugs, two piles of trouble. If you find yourself apologising to any of them out loud, that's normal. It helps. Probably.

complete.text: Six! Six honest plugs, barely scratched. You have gentle forks, courier.
I talked to the last one. Like you said. It didn't help. I still did it.
It always helps. You just can't hear the difference yet. Stick around the yard, you will.
